name: @hmux/monorepo
//pi: Lets `pi install git:github.com/djgrant/hmux` load the pi extension. pi treats the repo root as the package, so the manifest and the extension's runtime deps live here even though the source is under packages/pi-plugin. These are runtime deps (not dev) so pi's `npm install --omit=dev` installs them into the clone's root node_modules, where the extension resolves them by walking up. typebox is also bundled by pi at runtime, but declaring it here removes any reliance on that; @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent is a type-only import (erased), so it is not needed at runtime.
